originality: Original generated painted materials. No copyrighted game images, reference pixels or procedural stand-ins.

sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted ground-material texture atlas for the top-down 2D fantasy strategy game Aurelion Reach. Generate a square high-resolution 2048x2048 image divided mathematically into four equal square quadrants, a strict 2x2 atlas. Each quadrant is one completely filled ground material, independently seamless/tileable along its opposite edges. Quadrants meet at exact horizontal and vertical midlines with NO margins, borders, padding, gaps, labels, text or grid strokes. Consistent directly overhead orthographic camera, small-scale hand-painted natural detail, diffuse ambient daylight, no directional lighting gradient, no vignette, no perspective, no horizon. Looks like beautifully painted miniature landscape floor at strategic map scale, not a macro photograph and not plastic/procedural noise. Fine crisp detail with quietly irregular larger patches; moderate restrained contrast, rich nuanced colors. No trees, buildings, characters, large rocks, standalone props, roads, tracks, symbols, shadows cast by offscreen objects, or copied game pixels. No bilateral mirroring or kaleidoscope symmetry, no repeating radial motifs, no conspicuous vertical streaks. Ground should be readable beneath painted props. Output only the four-material atlas.
Material positions: TOP LEFT: natural lush meadow ground, muted fresh moss/olive grass, tiny uneven short tufts and scattered earth showing through, no large flowers. TOP RIGHT: sun-dried open plains, sage and straw-colored grass interleaved with dusty earth, still clearly grassland. BOTTOM LEFT: shaded deep-forest floor, rich dark moss and leaf litter with tiny root threads, no tree trunks or canopies. BOTTOM RIGHT: wet fen soil, muted olive and umber moss, small damp pools and fine reed stubble, no large water surfaces.

runtime.preparation: python3 -B tools/prepare_overworld_ground_materials.py; crop each exact quadrant, Lanczos resize to 508, pack 512 cells with duplicated two-pixel gutters. No mirrored image construction or color edits.
runtime.sampling: World-space six-tile painted materials with shader overlap at repeat seams and bounded four-neighbor biome splatting; center-of-tile identity protected.
